layout.body:
LIBRARY COMPUTER RESERVATION SYSTEM
Name:
Library Card Number:
Computer Station Preference:
·Basic (Internet only) ·Premium (Full software access)
Requested Date:
Time Slot: ·9-11 A.M. ·11 A.M.-1 P.M. ·1-3 P.M. ·3-5 P.M.
Maximum reservation time: 2 hours per day. Premium stations require advance booking and may be reserved up to one week in advance. Basic stations are available on a first-come first-served basis same day only. Late arrival (more than 15 minutes) results in automatic cancellation. Photo ID required at check-in.

questions.stem: What is this form used for?

options.A: Applying for a new library card
options.C: Booking time to use library computers

questions.analysis: What is this form used for? 原文依据：LIBRARY COMPUTER RESERVATION SYSTEM 图书馆电脑预约系统 (A) 申请新的借书证 → 错误 (B) 报告图书馆电脑故障 → 错误 (C) 预约使用图书馆电脑 → 正确 (D) 要求在电脑上安装软件 → 错误

questions.stem: How far in advance can someone reserve a Premium station?

options.D: Up to two weeks in advance

questions.analysis: How far in advance can someone reserve a Premium station? 原文依据：Premium stations require advance booking and may be reserved up to one week in advance. 高级电脑需要提前预约，最多可提前一周预约。 (A) 仅限当天 → 错误 (B) 最多提前一周 → 正确 (C) 最多提前一个月 → 错误 (D) 最多提前两周 → 错误

questions.stem: What happens if someone arrives 20 minutes late for their reservation?

options.A: They can still use the computer for the remaining time.
options.B: They must pay an additional fee.
options.D: They are moved to a Basic station instead.

questions.analysis: What happens if someone arrives 20 minutes late for their reservation? 原文依据：Late arrival (more than 15 minutes) results in automatic cancellation. 迟到（超过 15 分钟）预约将自动取消。 (A) 仍可在剩余时间使用电脑 → 错误 (B) 必须支付额外费用 → 错误 (C) 预约自动取消 → 正确 (D) 被换到基础电脑 → 错误
